selected_script.angle: range hood plastic grease trap cup filled with sticky oil turns into a cloudy slippery mess when rinsed with plain hot water
selected_script.hook: Extreme close-up of a plastic range hood grease trap filled with amber oil. Hot water runs over it in the sink, but the grease just turns into a stubborn, cloudy, slippery coating that clings to the plastic instead of washing away.

timeline.scene: Extreme close-up of a sticky range hood grease trap under hot water, becoming a slippery, cloudy mess instead of washing clean.
NUAN Heavy Duty Degreaser is sprayed directly into the cup. Dense foam covers the grease, immediately lifting and melting the amber oil.
The grease trap is rinsed under water, instantly revealing crystal-clear plastic with zero oily residue.
Fast cut to the foam being sprayed on a greasy stovetop and wiped away effortlessly with a blue microfiber towel in one swipe.
Fast cut to the inside of an air fryer basket being sprayed and wiped, leaving a spotless, grease-free surface.
The pristine white and green NUAN bottle sits on the clean kitchen counter. Text: 'A simple upgrade for everyday use.'
